questions.q: You run 'sudo apt update' on your Raspberry Pi. What does this command actually do?
choices: Downloads and installs all available software updates
Removes old packages that are no longer needed
Refreshes the list of available packages without installing anything
Restarts the Pi so new software can take effect
questions.explain: 'sudo apt update' only refreshes the package catalogue — it does not install anything. You need 'sudo apt full-upgrade -y' as a separate second step to actually download and install the updates.

questions.q: You want to check whether your Raspberry Pi 5 has been throttling due to heat since the last reboot. Which command gives you this information?
choices: vcgencmd measure_temp
htop
df -h
vcgencmd get_throttled
questions.explain: 'vcgencmd get_throttled' reads a status word from the hardware; a result of 0x0 means no throttling has occurred since the last reboot. 'vcgencmd measure_temp' shows the current temperature but not whether throttling happened.

questions.q: During boot, the green ACT LED flashes in a steady repeating pattern of 4 flashes then a pause. What should you do?
choices: Re-flash the microSD card using Raspberry Pi Imager
Wait longer — 4 flashes means the Pi is copying files and will finish soon
Replace the power supply with the included 27 W supply
Enable SSH using raspi-config so the Pi can finish booting
questions.explain: A repeating 4-flash pattern means 'start.elf cannot be launched', which points to a card or image problem. Re-flashing the microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager is the fix for all single-digit blink-code errors.

questions.q: You try to install a Python library with 'pip install requests' on Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm and see an 'externally-managed-environment' error. What is the correct explanation?
choices: Your internet connection is down and pip cannot reach the package server
Bookworm intentionally blocks pip from writing to the system Python to protect the OS
The 'requests' library does not exist for Python 3
You need to run 'sudo apt update' before pip will work
questions.explain: This error is deliberate, not a bug. Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm protects the system Python from being broken by pip installs. The recommended solutions are to use 'sudo apt install python3-requests', create a virtual environment, or use Thonny's package manager.

questions.q: Why is it important to always shut the Raspberry Pi down cleanly rather than simply unplugging the power?
choices: The Active Cooler fan must spin down safely or it will overheat
The Pi needs time to close network connections before it can be used again
Unplugging power damages the USB-C socket on the board
Cutting power while the card is writing data can corrupt the microSD card
questions.explain: The microSD card is the most fragile part of the Pi setup. If power is cut while the card is in the middle of a write operation, files can become garbled or the filesystem can become unreadable. Always use the desktop Shutdown menu, 'sudo shutdown -h now', or the physical power button to shut down cleanly.
